key.name: enabled
key.description: Whether the equalizer processes the sound of the default output device. When off, the sound passes through unchanged.

key.name: bands
key.description: Gain in decibels (−12 to +12) of the 60 Hz, 180 Hz, 550 Hz, 1.6 kHz, 5 kHz and 15 kHz bands.

key.name: preset
key.description: Identifier of the preset the band gains were taken from, or “custom”.

key.name: loudness-equalization
key.description: Evens out the perceived volume, so quiet passages are raised and loud ones are lowered.

key.name: bass-boost
key.description: Boosts the lowest frequencies with a low shelf filter.

key.name: bass-boost-level
key.description: How much the bass boost raises the low frequencies, in decibels.
